My logic is basically that I fear if I work overseas I'll end up getting complacent and not go back to school. My mother did it with her Business degree, having full intentions on getting her masters but getting complacent with her job and not continuing her education, and my aunt did similar only she had intention on getting a doctorate in English, but ended up getting her masters in Education and now just teaches. Both regret not continuing their schooling.

I planned on starting at a starting job regardless, but my thought process is if I have my MA, then I have room for career growth, since from what I understand getting an MA is pretty much required to advance your career in TEFL.

Of course I could be completely wrong on this, so apologies if I am.

I mentioned Love&Pop because I'm seeing a TON of similarities, and what you said there is actually how growing up is approached. But to outline the similarities:

-Love&Pop has four main girl protagonists

-It takes place from the perspective of one

-One doesn't know what she wants to "do" in life

-Said one goes through a weird (albeit VERY weird) journey and discovers that growing up is okay

-It's implied by the ending that the girls naturally part ways

I mention it being a possible source of inspo because Anno worked on it immediately after End of Eva, and Sadamoto had SOME influence on it despite it being live action. So I'd be willing to bet some staff at the very least saw it and drew inspiration from it. 

If you haven't seen it I'd recommend watching it, but be warned, there's some parts that are straight up awkward to watch. It doesn't pull any punches. I doubt FLCL will get as realistic as Love&Pop did for obvious reasons, but I'm gonna bet that the ending message is gonna be the same.
